additional_info.subject: 0416602 - ID0411585-DC/Si-D/AT-[MP / S2 170003381] RFID reader not working (C1) CRM:00646000030
additional_info.body:
Dear Daniel,
I hope all is well with you. I'm Sambath, and I'll be supporting you on this case from expert team. As we discussed last day, request you to plan a site intervention to check the healthiness of USB port on KF1. There might be chance of port is faulted and RFID reader is not accessible for the controller. You can evaluate the possibility with swapping the USB cables between HMI touch controller & RFID card reader. Please update me before you plan the intervention so that I can be available during your visit.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Sambath.K.S
